MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

5. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 8

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 38

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 81

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

22. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 8

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 55

24. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
